title: Supported events
content_data:
Events are defined as actions a visitor takes to achieve a business goal, such as adding an item to a cart, filling out a form, or making a purchase. TikTok supports two categories of events: - **Standard Events**: These are pre-defined actions with specific names created by TikTok. Standard events are compatible with all TikTok integration tools and can be used for reporting, conversion optimization, and audience building. For a list of supported standard events, continue reading below. - **Custom Events**: These are actions that TikTok partners can define beyond the list of pre-defined standard events. Custom events can be set up using the Event Builder in Events Manager or reported directly through the Pixel and Events API.
**Custom events (currently only custom web, app, and CRM (Customer relationship management) events are supported) are available for reporting and audience creation purposes. Optimization is NOT supported at this time.** To learn about how to use custom events, refer to [Standard and Custom Events](https://ads.tiktok.com/help/article/standard-events-parameters?lang=en). ## Web Standard Events The table below lists all the standard events supported on the web, including offline events where the `event_source` is `web`, along with the recommended fields for the `properties` object. Note that the names of the events are case-sensitive, so it is important to use the exact name shown in the **Event** column as the `event` parameter in [/event/track/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1771101303285761). ```xtable | Event{25%} | Description{37%} | Recommended fields in properties object{38%} | |---|---|---| | `AddPaymentInfo` | When payment information is added in the checkout flow. | | | `AddToCart` | When an item is added to the shopping cart. | `content_type`, `quantity`, `description`, `content_id`, `currency`, `value` | | `AddToWishlist` | When an item is added to a wishlist. | | | `ApplicationApproval` | When an application is approved. | | | `CompleteRegistration` | When a registration is completed. | | | `Contact` | When contact or consultation occurs. | | | `CustomizeProduct` | When someone customizes a product. | | | `Download` | When a button to open an external browser download page is clicked. | | | `FindLocation` | When someone tries to find your location. | | | `InitiateCheckout` | When the checkout process is started. | | | `Lead` | When a form is submitted. | | | `Purchase` | When a payment is completed. | `content_type`, `quantity`, `description`, `content_id`, `currency`, `value` | | `Schedule` | When someone makes an appointment to speak with your business or visit your location.| | | `Search` | When a search is made. | | | `StartTrial` | When someone begins a free trial of a product or service. | `currency`, `value` | | `SubmitApplication` | When someone submits an application | | | `Subscribe` | When a subscription is made. | | | `ViewContent` | When a page is viewed. | `content_type`, `quantity`, `description`, `content_id`, `currency`, `value` | ``` ## App Standard Events > **Note**
> Event names for data connection purposes (the `event` field) are different from event names in ad group creation (the `optimization_event` field). See the corresponding columns for the correct values. ```xtable | Event name for event data connection
